data.query: HairOriginals competitors alternatives Permanent Hair Extensions
data.answer: The sources mention several competitors of HairOriginals in the permanent hair extensions market. These include Mayvenn, Luvme Hair, Nish Hair, Parfait, and Indique. Mayvenn, Luvme Hair, and Nish Hair are listed as top D2C hair extensions brands startups, while Parfait is also noted among the top brands. Indique is highlighted as a pioneer in the virgin hair extension industry, emphasizing quality and ethical sourcing. The Hair Extension Market report lists Great Lengths Universal Hair Extensions Srl, Balmain Hair Group B.V., Hair Visions International, LE Belleza Hair and Beauty, SO.CAP. Original USA, Cinderella Hair, Racoon International, Evergreen Products Group Limited, Easihair Pro USA, and Hairlocs as competitors. The sources do not provide a definitive answer on which competitor is the best alternative to HairOriginals.
